verdict.rationale: Outlook's own Inbox rules are documented as background automations that act on incoming messages without user intervention, such as forwarding. Automatic replies also run unattended. However, the evidence shows only rule-based, message-triggered actions, not general-purpose or agentic automations. Change notifications are developer building blocks and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: scheduled/recurring automations, AI-driven or agentic autonomous workflows, triggers beyond incoming mail, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
